1b.far: dusk, a dark dense conifer forest ridge in layers, blue-grey far mountains, a thin column of grey smoke rising from a distant crash site behind the ridge, cool evening light
1b.mid: dark pine trunks and undergrowth, a fallen tree, mossy boulders, a wrecked purple alien UFO hull half-buried with a few bent metal plates, torn parachute cloth on a branch, scattered glowing purple debris (tiny), ferns
1b.ground: dark forest floor: pine needles, roots, moss, a few purple metal shards, packed dark soil below
1b.palette: evening - deep greens, blue-grey, dark brown, small purple accents

1c.far: sunset, long rolling ridge lines in warm orange and purple haze, a distant radio mast on a hilltop, a few bare trees in silhouette
1c.mid: hilltop defence line: sandbag walls, a wooden watchtower, coils of barbed wire on posts, a tank trap, a torn military flag, dry grass clumps, ammo crates
1c.ground: dry hillside dirt road, dead grass, gravel, shell craters, cracked earth below
1c.palette: sunset - orange, ochre, dusty purple shadows, khaki

1d.far: night, an alien hive landscape: giant purple fleshy mounds and bone-white spikes against the dark, glowing pink pods, a huge dark nest silhouette with a red glow at its core
1d.mid: alien growth: purple tendrils and tentacles rising from the ground, pulsing pink egg sacs, bone spikes, webbed membranes between stalks, a half-swallowed farmhouse ruin wrapped in purple flesh
1d.ground: ground covered by purple alien flesh and veins with glowing pink cracks, a few bone shards, dark fleshy layers below
1d.palette: night - deep purple, magenta glow (NOT pure #FF00FF, use #d040c0 and darker), bone white, near black; keep the pure magenta #FF00FF strictly for the empty background

2a.far: overcast grey day, a ruined city skyline: broken concrete towers, a collapsed bridge, cranes, smoke plumes, distant purple alien spire just visible
2a.mid: ruined street: cracked apartment facades with broken windows, a tipped bus, rubble piles, a burnt car, lamp posts leaning, a traffic light, torn posters, concrete barriers
2a.ground: cracked asphalt road with a kerb and painted lane markings along the top, rubble, rebar, dark concrete and soil layers below
2a.palette: grey overcast - concrete greys, rust, dull blue, dirty white

2b.far: underground: a long subway tunnel wall receding, concrete arches and pillars, rows of pipes and cables, dim green emergency lamps along the wall
2b.mid: subway / sewer scenery: a derailed subway car, ticket gates, tiled walls with graffiti, big sewer pipes dripping, valve wheels, a ladder, puddles with green glow, stacked crates, rats
2b.ground: subway platform edge / wet sewer walkway along the top (tiles and a rail), dark brick and concrete below with a water channel
2b.palette: underground - dark teal, concrete grey, green emergency light, rust

2c.far: high above the city: tops of skyscrapers below the horizon line, clouds at eye level, a bright blue sky, a few helicopters-sized specks, far alien spire
2c.mid: rooftop clutter: water tanks, air-conditioning units, antenna masts, a billboard frame, a rooftop shed, a helipad marking, chimneys, safety railings, laundry lines
2c.ground: flat rooftop: concrete slabs with tar seams along the top, a low parapet edge, vents, the building's upper floor windows below
2c.palette: bright high altitude - sky blue, white, light concrete, orange safety accents

2d.far: night, a city consumed by alien growth: skyscrapers wrapped in purple flesh, a colossal alien spire / control tower with glowing pink rings, purple lightning in the clouds
2d.mid: plaza ruins overtaken: a fountain filled with purple ooze, statues wrapped in tendrils, alien pods on the buildings, bone-white structures growing from the pavement, a crashed helicopter cocooned
2d.ground: plaza paving stones cracked by purple veins and glowing pink fissures along the top, alien flesh and dark layers below
2d.palette: night - deep purple, pink glow (#d040c0 and darker, never pure #FF00FF), near black, bone white; pure magenta #FF00FF strictly for the empty background
